comment: sha256 of every web file a mobile override copies or wraps with changed behaviour, as it was when the override was last brought in step with it, grouped by area. check-drift.cjs (npm run check:drift, also run by the areas' *-drift.test.ts) fails when one of them changes.
When it fails: git -C web diff <web below> HEAD -- src/<file>, port every hunk into the file's `port` list, update its sha256, and set `web` to the new submodule commit.

An area's `covers` are web/src path prefixes: an override of a module under one of them (manifest entry or @web-original/ import outside tests) must be pinned here. A wrapper that only re-exports needs no pin; list it under the area's `unpinned` with the reason.

voice.note: stores/voice.ts is a copy that keeps its M1-M9 list of mobile changes; the lib/voice leaves are native implementations behind the same exports.

e2ee.note: machine.ts and keyBackup.ts are copies of the web modules with the engine in the crypto host WebView (src/platform/crypto/README.md); keyBackup's unwrap and import flows run in the host page, so a change to them is ported into crypto-host/src/backup.ts too. Every other lib/e2ee module and the stores/e2ee* stores run unchanged.
